name: Playback Info
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Playback info overlay, playback properties and the About window
description: Shows live facts at the top left of the video (Tab): file, time, codecs, frame rate and more, or a short summary with Shift+Tab. Playback Properties… lists the decoding state, the file's streams and metadata, and system information, to copy or save as text. About Vestra Player… shows the version, components and loaded plugins.
